policy: document -> pin -> smoke -> regression -> merge; no floating 'latest' pins; nothing here is a runtime dependency of the game

tools.reason: Design validators, unit tests, toolchain scripts; stdlib only
tools.install: Install CPython from python.org (Windows) or the OS package manager; CI uses actions/setup-python
tools.removal_plan: Never a game runtime dependency; scripts stay stdlib-only
tools.ci_impact: setup-python per job, no extra packages

tools.reason: Live verification of HEAD, PR, CI for CURRENT_STATE; PR creation and merge
tools.install: cli.github.com; authenticate with 'gh auth login' (token never committed)
tools.removal_plan: GitHub web UI is an equivalent manual fallback

tools.reason: ADR-001 engine pin; binary smoke now, project import from P0-00
tools.removal_plan: Engine is the platform; upgrades only through an ADR-001 amendment
tools.ci_impact: ~80 MB download per OS, cached by version key

tools.reason: gdformat/gdlint for typed GDScript once game/ exists
tools.install: python -m pip install gdtoolkit==4.5.0 (in a venv; deferred until game/ exists)
tools.removal_plan: Drop if Godot built-in formatter covers the same checks
tools.ci_impact: pip install in lint job after P0-00

tools.reason: Godot unit/integration tests (s21 primary runner; gdUnit4 is the alternative, never both)
tools.install: python scripts/dev/godot_tool.py gut-install (extracts addons/gut into game/addons/gut, git-ignored, tree digest verified)
tools.integration_test: python scripts/dev/godot_tool.py test (GUT finds >0 tests; an intentionally failing test makes the run exit non-zero)
tools.removal_plan: Switch to gdUnit4 only with an ADR
tools.ci_impact: runs inside the Godot headless job after P0-00
tools.tree_digest_policy:
sha256 over sorted lines '<path relative to subtree>�<sha256 hex of file bytes>
'; GitHub archive bytes are not a stable contract
